title: Printed paper-collage explainer style
what_it_does: A full look pack: cream paper, halftone dots, heavy ink type, one yellow highlighter, hand annotations, paper slap-ins, one sheet-wipe cut. Includes palette tokens (brand-tokens.css), tuned motion defaults, process laws and a renderable one-scene HyperFrames starter.
when_to_use: Editorial / documentary explainers with a printed look.
why: Written for HyperFrames and its starter lints with 0 errors on 0.9.67 (2 warnings). MIT. Small repo (5 stars, last push 2026-07-14) but the content is concrete. Do not use Vox logos or imply affiliation; rename to 'paper collage' in our catalog.
